findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "verify_url" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: URL syntax validator. Takes one absolute HTTP or HTTPS URL and returns its normalized form, or a specific error code: unparseable, unsupported scheme, embedded …

findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "ping" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: check_site_safety, check_sites_batch, read_page, link_preview, check_email, seo_check, crypto_price, check_prompt_injection, read_feed · Private data: verify_url, check_sites_batch, transcribe_audio, read_page, domain_report, chain_balance, chain_token, new_uuid, ip_info, ping · Public sink: check_sites_batch, domain_report, check_email · Destructive: check_email.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: check_site_safety, check_sites_batch, read_page, link_preview, check_email, seo_check, crypto_price, check_prompt_injection, read_feed · Private data: verify_url, check_sites_batch, transcribe_audio, read_page, domain_report, chain_balance, chain_token, new_uuid, ip_info, ping · Public sink: check_sites_batch, domain_report, check_email · Destructive: check_email

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
